Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Be aged 10-18 years at the time of surgery
  -  Have a diagnosis of idiopathic scoliosis  [OR] and/or kyphosis
  -  Be undergoing elective posterior spinal fusion
  -  Have only mild systemic disease
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  A diagnosis of neuromuscular scoliosis  [OR] and/or kyphosis
  -  A diagnosis of chronic pain
  -  Used opioids in the past 6 months
  -  Developmental delay
  -  Liver  [OR] or kidney disease
  -  Obstructive sleep apnea
  -  Body mass index >40
  -  Be pregnant  [OR] or breastfeeding
